profile.preferredStrategy: Mixed procurement between Japan and China

rules.title: Compare landed cost, not sticker price
rules.detail: Include exchange rate, checkout discounts, shipping, tax, baggage or forwarding cost and realistic warranty return cost.

rules.title: Discover products before repricing
rules.detail: Every monthly cycle adds new releases, flags discontinued products and avoids a frozen model list.

rules.title: Weight warranty by failure impact
rules.detail: PSU, motherboard, GPU and display receive a larger local-warranty penalty than CPU, RAM or air cooling.

rules.title: Missing price is not zero
rules.detail: A retailer quote appears only when source, date, stock and price type are recorded.
